task.title: M8: External dependency footprint (which modules import which third-party packages)
task.description:
The resolvers already classify an import as external and then drop it. Keep it: record external package names (npm package name including scope, Go module path) as edges from the importing file to a synthetic node of kind 'external', so the snapshot knows which files touch which third-party packages. Add a view (or a mode in the Graph view) listing externals ranked by number of importing files, with click-to-highlight of every file that imports a given package. Node builtins (node:*, Go stdlib) are recorded but grouped separately. Compare view reports externals added and removed between refs. This is the data half of the lockfile-over-time idea in the Ideas Draft.

Acceptance criteria:
- Snapshot edges include kind:'external' edges with the package name as the target id; existing module and file edge consumers ignore them.
- A list in the UI shows each external with its importing-file count; selecting one highlights importing files on the treemap and graph.
- Compare summary lists externals newly introduced and fully removed between base and head.
- Cache invalidation via a tool version bump; one test on the external-name extraction for scoped npm packages and Go module paths.
